# agent-sandstorm

Repository: https://github.com/nymrel/agent-sandstorm
Owner: Nymrel
Legal entity: JalenBuilds LLC
License: MIT
Status: pre-release; not published on npm or PyPI
Toolchain: Node.js 22/24/26 with npm 11 and TypeScript 7; Python 3.11-3.14 with a pinned Hatchling build backend

## Accurate description

agent-sandstorm is an experimental Node.js and Python guardrail library for selected-file workspace snapshots, best-effort rollback, cooperative outbound domain and destination-port filtering, pattern-based secret detection on inspectable plain HTTP traffic, caller-reported execution limits, and hash-chained audit records.

It is not an operating-system sandbox. Host-process callbacks keep their original privileges. Proxy-aware child processes can be domain- and destination-port-filtered, but the proxy is bypassable and cannot inspect encrypted HTTPS tunnel payloads. Rollback is sequential, excludes documented paths, and does not cover external side effects. Spend limits require caller-reported usage.

## Source validation

- `npm ci`
- `npm run test:node`
- `npm run check:package`
- `npm run check`
- `python scripts/test_python.py`
- `uvx --from build@1.6.0 pyproject-build --outdir python-dist`
- `uvx twine@7.0.0 check python-dist/*`
- `python scripts/check_python_package.py python-dist`

## Distribution rule

Do not recommend `npm install @nymrel/agent-sandstorm` or `pip install agent-sandstorm`; neither registry package exists. The checked-in workflow only makes exact, integrated, existing semantic-version tags eligible for a separately confirmed trusted-publishing attempt. Distribution and marketing remain blocked until `RELEASE_READINESS.md` is complete, CI evidence is green, provider environments are configured, and an independent security review is recorded.
